+def _stat_key(path: Path) -> tuple[str, int, int]:
+    """Identify one file version by path, size and modification time in nanoseconds."""
+    stat = path.stat()
+    return str(path), stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns
+
+
+def cached_sha256(path: str | Path) -> str:
+    """Stream a file's SHA-256 once per (path, size, mtime_ns) in this process.
+
+    A file that changes while it is read is an error rather than a cached torn digest.
+    """
+    path = Path(path)
+    key = _stat_key(path)
+    if key not in _FILE_SHA256:
+        digest = sha256_file(path)
+        if _stat_key(path) != key:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"{path} changed while it was hashed")
+        _FILE_SHA256[key] = digest
+    return _FILE_SHA256[key]
+
+
+def package_tree_sha256(root: str | Path) -> tuple[str, int]:
+    """Digest every file below ``root``; return the digest and the number of non-directory entries.
+
+    Each regular file contributes the ``sha256sum`` line ``"<sha256 of its bytes>  <relative POSIX
+    path>\\n"`` and the lines are sorted bytewise by relative path, so for a tree of regular files whose
+    names hold no backslash or newline the digest equals ``cd ROOT && find . -type f | sed 's|^[.]/||'
+    | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs -d '\\n' sha256sum | sha256sum``. A symlink contributes
+    ``symlink:<sha256 of its target text>`` instead of being followed, so nothing outside ``root`` is
+    read; empty directories contribute nothing and other file types are rejected. File bodies are
+    streamed, so memory grows with the number of paths only.
+    """
+    root = Path(root)
+    relative_paths: list[str] = []
+    pending = [root]
+    while pending:
+        with os.scandir(pending.pop()) as entries:
+            for entry in entries:
+                if entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
+                    pending.append(Path(entry.path))
+                else:
+                    relative_paths.append(Path(entry.path).relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    for relative in sorted(relative_paths, key=os.fsencode):
+        path = root / relative
+        if path.is_symlink():
+            content = "symlink:" + hashlib.sha256(os.fsencode(os.readlink(path))).hexdigest()
+        elif path.is_file():
+            content = cached_sha256(path)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file type in package tree: {path}")
+        digest.update(content.encode() + b"  " + os.fsencode(relative) + b"\n")
+    return digest.hexdigest(), len(relative_paths)
+
+
+def real_binary_version(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Run the real binary itself with ``--version``, never a wrapper's cached answer.
+
+    The probe gets the credential-free child environment and a throwaway HOME, so files a binary
+    creates at start-up do not land in the user's home; it is bounded by
+    REAL_VERSION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and cached per (path, size, mtime_ns).
+    """
+    key = _stat_key(path)
+    if key not in _REAL_VERSIONS:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="humanclaw-version-", ignore_cleanup_errors=True) as home:
+            completed = subprocess.run([str(path), "--version"], cwd=home, env=child_environment(Path(home)),
+                                       stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True,
+                                       timeout=REAL_VERSION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
+        if completed.returncode != 0 or not completed.stdout.strip():
+            raise RuntimeError(f"{path} --version failed (exit {completed.returncode}, stdout "
+                               f"{completed.stdout.strip()[:200]!r}): {completed.stderr.strip()[-500:]}")
+        _REAL_VERSIONS[key] = completed.stdout.strip()
+    return _REAL_VERSIONS[key]
+

+def _pi_package_identity(value: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
